title.zh: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
title.en: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story

current_state.zh: Bitquery's updated blockchain analysis shows Mercado Bitcoin-linked deposit addresses were drained for nearly four hours after the exchange claimed containment, with $48.6 million stolen across 11 networks and withdrawals and trading still suspended.
